title: macOS Management Runbooks & IT-Support Enablement (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Give your team a repeatable way to run and support Macs
problem: macOS support gets inconsistent when there are no standard runbooks and the knowledge lives in one engineer's head. This solution provides a runbook library and enablement kit for managing and supporting Intune-managed Macs — enrollment, SSO setup, passwordless/FileVault procedures, incident response, and staff training — so IT support resolves Mac issues consistently and new features get adopted deliberately.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the macOS support operating model, how the runbooks are structured, and how to keep them current as Intune/Apple features change.
Requirements Guide — what the team needs (Intune roles, Graph read access, remote tools, asset context) with how to verify each.

Runbook Library — step-by-step runbooks: ADE/enrollment, SSO setup, passwordless/FileVault procedures, app/VPP, BYOD, compliance/CA, and incident response (recover from encryption/SecureToken issues, account lock-outs) — each with triage, checks, and escalation gate.
5 PowerShell scripts — Mac fleet health/context discovery, per-device state validation, a support-metrics/health report, safe common-fix remediation, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates per runbook, plus Best Practices for documentation, training, and feature evaluation.
short: A runbook library and enablement kit for Intune-managed Macs — enrollment, SSO, passwordless/FileVault, app/VPP, BYOD, compliance, and incident response — so support is consistent and features get adopted deliberately. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A runbook library and enablement kit for Intune-managed Macs — enrollment, SSO, passwordless/FileVault, app/VPP, BYOD, compliance, and incident response — so support is consistent and features get adopted deliberately.
meta_description: Standardized runbooks + enablement for Intune-managed Macs: enrollment, SSO, passwordless/FileVault, app/VPP, BYOD, compliance, and incident response, with staff-training guidance. Self-guided steps and scripts.
bottom_line: A Mac-support team that resolves issues the same repeatable way and adopts new features deliberately — a runbook library and scripts you keep and reuse across the fleet.
